lines.en: Long fur dragging frost as I walk.

lines.zh: 象牙先拨开雪，我才迈步
lines.en: Tusks clear the snow before I step.
The frozen ground creaks underfoot.
I can bear the ice-age wind.
Each step shakes my shaggy coat.
Two plumes of white breath leave my trunk.
This coat is the glacier's gift.
Easy now, watch for holes.
Only my tracks cross this snowfield.

lines.zh: 象牙太长了，走路得抬高
lines.en: Tusks this long must be carried high.
I walk at the back of the herd.
The ice is as hard as my bones.

lines.zh: 踩出一条路，后面的跟来
lines.en: I break a trail; the rest follow.
Frost on my fur, yet I'm warm.

lines.zh: 冰河期的黄昏，走起来最静
lines.en: Ice-age dusk is the quietest walking.
Four legs, steady even in snow.
However hard the wind blows, this fur is enough.
Standing, I'm a fur-covered hill.
The ice field is quiet; I listen.
Tusks resting in the snow a while.
Humans lived through this ice age too.
I remember the taste of snow.

lines.zh: 象群在远处，我守在这里
lines.en: The herd's far off; I hold here.
My shaggy hair covers my eyes.

lines.zh: 四十点血肉，二十一点蛮力
lines.en: Forty points of flesh, twenty-one of force.
There are grass roots under the permafrost.
Curling my trunk tip to keep it warm.

lines.zh: 冰河期的老家伙，还站得稳
lines.en: Old ice-age fellow, still standing firm.
Snow settles on my back; I don't move.
This world is far younger than I am.
You're wrapped up thinner than I am.

lines.zh: 小东西，别站在我牙前面
lines.en: Little one, don't stand in front of my tusks.
Your scent says you're new here.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看块石头
lines.en: I lower my head and size you up like a stone.
Cold? It's warm enough in here.
You want to touch a tusk? Think first.
Has the herd gotten a new member?

lines.zh: 你太小了，我差点没看见
lines.en: You're so small I nearly missed you.
We can look at each other, but don't raise a hand.
On this ice field, you're a rare guest.
It hurts, but this coat is thick.
You dare strike me; the herd will remember.

lines.zh: 长毛挡了一层，可还是疼
lines.en: The fur took some, but it still hurts.
A pained trumpet shakes the snow.
I can bear this wound.
Blood on snow is hard to miss.
I stepped back, but not from fear.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的步子
lines.en: That blow broke my stride.
Old bones feel pain too.
Don't let there be a second.
That bundle of grass smells fine.

lines.zh: 冰下挖草根太费劲，你有现成的
lines.en: Digging roots under ice is hard; you have them ready.
Slow down, my legs are short.
Don't shake your hand; my trunk is long.
One bite of this lasts me half a day.
The ice-age appetite never left.
I'll follow, as long as there's more.

lines.zh: 象群不让吃独食，我先来
lines.en: The herd won't share; I'll go first.
My trunk scoops up a mouthful first.
That handful is just an appetizer.

lines.zh: 撞上我的毛，你滑下去了
lines.en: You hit my fur and slid off.
Step aside, I stop slowly.

lines.zh: 象牙扫到你了，我不是故意的
lines.en: My tusk caught you; it wasn't on purpose.

lines.zh: 这么厚的毛，撞着也不疼
lines.en: Fur this thick doesn't mind a bump.
You're blocking my snow trail.
I'm lifting a foot; move.
The snow is slick, and so are you.
Hitting me is hitting an iceberg.
I turn sideways to let you pass.
This body is too heavy to rein in.

lines.zh: 象牙轻轻碰一下，算问候
lines.en: Tusks touch lightly in greeting.
Even the ice age deserves a spring.
Two shaggy bodies walking side by side.
You came looking for a mate too.
Fur against fur is warmer.
Take your time; my life is long.
The snowfield is wide enough for us.
A low rumble, and I agree.
The herd will gain one more.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印要并在一起
lines.en: Our tracks should run side by side.
My trunk hooks it up.
I'll pick up what's in the snow.
Roots? I'll take them.
My trunk tip is nimbler than a hand.
This mouthful of grass, chewed slowly.
I pick it up slowly; no hurry.
Something's buried under the snow.
That little tuft, my trunk takes it.
Fallen fruit belongs to the herd.
Picked up and tucked in my fur.
My tusks are already aimed at you.
You poked me; don't regret it.
On ice I charge faster than I look.
Twenty-one points of force, enough for you.

lines.zh: 一声象鸣，整片雪都在抖
lines.en: A trumpet, and the whole snowfield shakes.
You stepped on the frozen ground I grazed.
I only wanted to eat grass.
My fur is standing up.
Don't run; you can't outrun me.
You can't take this charge.

lines.zh: 雪原上没东西挡住象牙
lines.en: Nothing on this snowfield stops a tusk.
You've roused the wrong shaggy beast.
I bear down, step by step.
My shadow covers the snow.
My trunk knows where you are.
Tusks lowered, ready to gore.
I'm patient; you'll tire.
My footfalls grow heavier.
The herd is watching behind me.
You can't circle out of this.
The ice field offers no cover.
One step closer and I strike.
I lower my tusks and charge at you.

lines.zh: 这身毛在动，说明我要冲
lines.en: My fur shifting means I'm about to charge.
That breathing you hear is mine.
A tusk flick, and you're airborne.
My forefoot slams down.
My trunk whips across.
This gore hits like a battering ram.
The ice is slick, so I hit harder.
You stood in front of my tusks.
The herd's anger.
This blow throws up the snow.
Don't say I didn't warn you.
Under the fur, it's all muscle.
I come down on you like an avalanche.
This step lands square.

lines.zh: 冰河期的风把我吹来了
lines.en: The ice-age wind blew me in.
My shaggy coat emerges from the snow mist first.
Tusks have cut open this frozen ground.
My first step, and the snow gives way.
A mammoth walks into the modern age.
The herd's scent lingers.
Forty points of flesh stands on the ice.
The breathing of an older age.
I arrive, bringing the whole glacier.
One more shadow on the snowfield.
The permafrost wakes.
Don't fear me; I only want grass.
A long trumpet, reporting in.

lines.zh: 毛上还挂着上一个冰期
lines.en: Last ice age's frost still clings to me.

lines.zh: 毛烧起来了，我拍打象牙
lines.en: My fur is burning; I beat it with my tusks.
I fell from a height; my legs are numb.

lines.zh: 水漫过鼻子，我拼命举高
lines.en: Water covers my trunk; I strain to lift it.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵里全是响声
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears full of noise.
Something has lodged in my thick fur.
This pain bleeds nothing, and that's worse.

lines.zh: 冻土下没有草，我饿得发虚
lines.en: No grass under the frost; hunger weakens me.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我的背，毛都焦了
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and singed the fur.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我这么重也在掉
lines.en: The ground is gone; even my weight falls.
